types: integer,text,boolean and null only; UTF-8 text compared with binary/codepoint ordering; no locale-sensitive collation or numeric/float conversion
supported: SELECT/WHERE/ORDER BY, one nonrecursive CTE, DISTINCT ON with leading ORDER BY keys, text-only concat, IS DISTINCT FROM, PostgreSQL $n parameters; ordinary arithmetic/comparison/boolean/null expressions
distinct_order: accepted DISTINCT ON ordering must include event_id after its grouping keys so the selected row is unambiguous; reject otherwise rather than append order
target_boolean: SQLite integer 0/1 for boolean, mapped back to logical type in result schema
output: SQLite SQL, parameter mapping, output schema and per-rewrite source evidence; helper columns do not become output
unsupported: regex, user functions, DML, recursive CTEs, external tables and unspecified dialect features
parameter_types: each query declares parameter_types in $1..$n order; validate and use these types when binding in PostgreSQL and mapping to SQLite
